record.question:
With reference to India, consider the following events :
(i) Nationalisation of Banks, 1969.
(ii) Formation of Regional Rural Banks. 1975.
(iii) Adoption of villages by Bank Branches.
(iv) Liberalization of the economy.
Which of the above events can be considered as steps taken to achieve 'financial inclusion in India'?
